text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create art, compose music, and even write stories. You can simply type an idea, and the computer produces a picture or a song in seconds. But is this real creativity? Humans create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. AI, however, learns from existing data and finds patterns. It does not feel joy, sadness, or surprise. So while AI can copy styles and produce impressive results, true creativity still belongs to people. Perhaps the best approach is to use AI as a helpful partner, not a replacement.
